blocks.text: The current-state review for {{fact:f:E-2009-003.client}} is on schedule, and I am writing chiefly to line up the data we will need for the next stage and to confirm the working session we discussed. Mary Parker has finished the first pass on the market and peer material, and I have most of the operating-model documentation in hand; the gap now is on the finance side, where three of the cost schedules we requested have not yet reached us from your team.

For the record, the attendee list for the session is Jason Torres, Mary Parker, and Daniel Leach from our side, with Joseph Wallace and the owners of the cost schedules from yours. Jason Torres will take everyone through the current-state findings, so it will help to have the people who maintain those schedules in the room and able to speak to them.
Could you have the three outstanding schedules sent to me by the middle of next week? With those in hand we can hold the session as planned and keep the review on its timeline.
